The '''1983–84 Serie A''' season was won by [[Juventus FC|Juventus]]. It was a tight championship, with reigning champions [[AS Roma|Roma]] providing strong opposition to the {{lang|it|Bianconeri}}, who obtained the point they needed by drawing 1-1 against [[U.S. Avellino 1912|Avellino]] on 6 May, taking the title with one match to spare.

==Teams==
[[A.C. Milan|Milan]], [[SS Lazio|Lazio]] and [[Catania Calcio|Catania]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].
